Aruqtai and others, Grand Preceptor of the Palace with the Insignia of the Three Excellencies, Upper Pillar of State, Recorder of Important Affairs of State and Military, Right Chancellor of the Central Secretariat, Supervisor of the Compilation of the National History, Director of the Classics Lectures, and supervisor of the affairs of the Xuanzheng Bureau, the Imperial Medical Institute, and the Broad Benefit Office, respectfully submit:
提調宣政院太醫院廣惠司事 coordinates three agencies under one 提調; the before text wrongly nests them as one bureau title, and the proposed rendering restores the parallel structure.

Your Majesty appointed Aruqtai and Left Chancellor Bayan Qutlugh to direct the history project, with former Right Chancellor Toqto'a as chief director-in-chief, and Chief Directors including Chief Councillors Temür Dash, Censor-in-Chief Weiyi, Hanlin Academicians Expositor Qiyan and Xuan, Investigating Censor Haowen, Minister of Rites Yi, and Director of the Directorate of Education Zongrui; together with Chief Councillors Nalin and Yan, former Right Vice Director of the Central Secretariat Dashimur, Left Vice Director Shoujian, Counsellors Yuezhu, Zhu, and Siqian, Bureau Directors Olon and Sili, and others to assist in reverent supervision; and history officers including Vice Minister of Works Oluntur, Secretary Director Taibuhua, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Du Bingyi, Hanlin Academician Song Xing, Rectors of the Directorate of Education Wang Sicheng and Zemin, Awaiting Editor-in-Chief of the Hall of Gathered Worthies Gan Wenchuan, Hanlin Awaiting Editors Zhang Jin and Shidao, Doctor of the Xuanwen Pavilion Mai Wengui, Investigating Censor Yu Que, Doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Li Qi, Hanlin Compiler Liu Wen, Chief Administrator of the Imperial Medical Institute Jia Lu, Instructors of the Directorate of Education Feng Fuke, Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple Office Chen Zuren, Western Censor Zhao Zhong, Hanlin Attendants Wang Yi and Zhen, Left Secretary Compiler Tan Kao, Hanlin Compiler Zhang Zhu, Instructor of the Directorate of Education Wu Dang, and Classics Lectures Reviewer Wei Su to edit in separate bureaus and gather the whole into a book.

Your Majesty appointed Aruqtai and Left Chancellor Bayan Qutlugh to direct the history project, with former Right Chancellor Toqto'a as chief director-in-chief, and Chief Directors including Chief Councillors Temür Dash, Censor-in-Chief Weiyi, Hanlin Academicians Expositor Qiyan and Xuan, Investigating Censor Haowen, Minister of Rites Yi, and Director of the Directorate of Education Zongrui; together with Chief Councillors Nalin and Yan, former Right Vice Director of the Central Secretariat Dashimur, Left Vice Director Shoujian, Counsellors Yuezhu, Zhu, and Siqian, Bureau Directors Olon and Sili, and others to assist in reverent supervision; and history officers including Vice Minister of Works Oluntur, Secretary Director Taibuhua, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Du Bingyi, Hanlin Academician Song Jiong, Rectors of the Directorate of Education Wang Sicheng and Zemin, Awaiting Editor-in-Chief of the Hall of Gathered Worthies Gan Wenchuan, Hanlin Awaiting Editors Zhang Jin and Shidao, Doctor of the Xuanwen Pavilion Mai Wengui, Investigating Censor Yu Que, Doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Li Qi, Hanlin Compiler Liu Wen, Chief Administrator of the Imperial Medical Institute Jia Lu, Instructors of the Directorate of Education Feng Fuke, Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple Office Chen Zuren, Western Censor Zhao Zhong, Hanlin Attendants Wang Yi and Zhen, Left Secretary Compiler Tan Zao, Hanlin Compiler Zhang Zhu, Instructor of the Directorate of Education Wu Dang, and Classics Lectures Reviewer Wei Su to edit in separate bureaus and gather the whole into a book.
宋褧 is Song Jiong (褧), not Xing; 譚慥 is Tan Zao (慥), not Kao; the proposed names match the Chinese characters.
Afterward Emperor Gong submitted to the court and the loyal princes took to the sea; when Qi perished they still sought out Wang Zhu—thus there remained ministers who held fast to their integrity;
Afterward Emperor Gong submitted to the court and Prince Ji took to the sea; when Qi perished they still sought out Wang Zhu—thus there remained ministers who held fast to their integrity;
吉王 is a singular title; "the loyal princes" invents a plural absent from 吉王航海, and Prince Ji restores the correct referent.
Afterward Emperor Ying submitted to the court and the Prince Ji took to the sea; when Qi perished they sought out Wang Zhu—thus there remained ministers who held to their integrity;
Afterward Yingguo submitted to the court and the Prince Ji took to the sea; when Qi perished they sought out Wang Zhu—thus there remained ministers who held to their integrity;
瀛國 is the Yingguo title of Song Gongdi after surrender, not a personal name "Emperor Ying"; the proposed Yingguo is the accurate literal rendering.
Although we fall short of the praise due to Dong Gu's upright brush, we may yet escape Sima Qian's fault of limited knowledge and credulous acceptance.
Although we fall short of the praise due to Dong Hu's upright brush, we may yet escape Sima Qian's fault of limited knowledge and credulous acceptance.
董孤 alludes to the upright historian Dong Hu (董狐); Gu is a mistaken romanization of 孤 in this set phrase.
Although slight compared with Dong Gu's upright brush that may be praised, we may yet escape Sima Qian's scant knowledge and light credulity.
Although slight compared with Dong Hu's upright brush that may be praised, we may yet escape Sima Qian's scant knowledge and light credulity.
Same allusion as the idiomatic field: 董孤 is Dong Hu, so Gu must be corrected in the literal as well.

units.zh: 進《宋史》表
units.en: Memorial Presenting the History of Song
units.literal: Memorial presenting the History of Song.

units.zh: 開府儀同三司、上柱國、錄軍國重事、中書右丞相、監修國史、領經筵事、提調宣政院太醫院廣惠司事 臣阿魯圖 等言：
units.en: Aruqtai and others, Grand Preceptor of the Palace with the Insignia of the Three Excellencies, Upper Pillar of State, Recorder of Important Affairs of State and Military, Right Chancellor of the Central Secretariat, Supervisor of the Compilation of the National History, Director of the Classics Lectures, and supervisor of the affairs of the Xuanzheng Bureau, the Imperial Medical Institute, and the Broad Benefit Office, respectfully submit:
units.literal: Grand Preceptor of the Palace with the Insignia of the Three Excellencies, Upper Pillar of State, Recorder of Important Affairs of State and Military, Right Chancellor of the Central Secretariat, Supervisor of the Compilation of the National History, Director of the Classics Lectures, Supervisor of the Broad Benefit Bureau of the Imperial Medical Institute of the Xuanzheng Bureau, your servant Aruqtai and others report:

units.zh: 竊惟周公念先業之艱難，《七月》之詩是作；
units.en: We venture to reflect that the Duke of Zhou, recalling the hardships of his forefathers' labors, composed the "Seventh Month";
units.literal: We venture to consider that the Duke of Zhou, mindful of the hardships of his forefathers' enterprise, therefore composed the poem "Seventh Month";

units.zh: 孔子論前王之文獻，二代之禮可言。
units.en: and that Confucius, expounding the records of former kings, showed that the rites of the Two Dynasties could still be set forth.
units.literal: Confucius discussed the documents of former kings, and the rites of the Two Dynasties could be spoken of.

units.zh: 故觀趙氏隆替之由，足見皇元混一之績。
units.en: Thus in tracing the rise and fall of the House of Zhao one may fully discern the achievement of the Great Yuan in unifying the realm.
units.literal: Therefore, observing the causes of the rise and fall of the House of Zhao suffices to show the achievement of the Great Yuan in unifying all.

units.zh: 欽惟世祖聖德神功文武皇帝，初由宗邸親總大軍，龍旂出指於離方，羽葆歸登於乾御，櫛風沐雨，詎辭跋履之勞；
units.en: We respectfully consider Emperor Shizu, Sagely in Virtue and Divine in Merit, Martial and Civil, who at first from his princely residence personally took command of the great army, sent the dragon banner forth toward the south, and with the feather canopy returned to ascend the northern throne—braving wind and rain and never shrinking from the hardship of long campaigns;
units.literal: We respectfully consider the Sagely Virtue, Divine Merit, Martial and Civil Emperor Shizu, who at first from his princely residence personally commanded the great army; the dragon banner went forth pointing toward the south; the feather canopy returned to mount the northern throne; he combed the wind and bathed in rain, how could he decline the toil of long marches;

units.zh: 略地攻城，咸遵禀授之算。
units.en: in seizing territory and storming cities, all followed the strategies Heaven had entrusted to him.
units.literal: in seizing territory and storming cities, all followed the plans received from above.

units.zh: 揚舲而平江、漢，卷甲而克襄、樊。
units.en: With sails raised he pacified the Yangtze and Han regions; with armies gathered he captured Xiangyang and Fancheng.
units.literal: Raising sails, he pacified the Yangtze and Han; rolling up armor, he conquered Xiang and Fan.

units.zh: 龔行吊伐之師，昭受寵綏之寄。
units.en: He marched as Heaven's avenger on a punitive campaign and plainly received the charge to secure the realm in imperial grace and peace.
units.literal: He righteously marched punitive forces and clearly received the charge of securing imperial favor and peace.

units.zh: 及夫收圖書於勝國，輯黼冔於神京，拔宋臣而列政塗，載《宋史》而歸秘府。
units.en: Then he gathered books from the conquered state, assembled ceremonial regalia in the sacred capital, raised Song officials to posts on the paths of government, and brought the History of Song into the imperial archives.
units.literal: When he had gathered books from the conquered state, collected ceremonial caps in the sacred capital, elevated Song officials to the roads of governance, and deposited the History of Song in the secret archives.

units.zh: 然後告成郊廟，錫慶臣民，推大賚以惟均，示一統之無外。
units.en: Thereafter he reported completion to the suburban altars, bestowed blessings on officials and people, extended great largess with impartial generosity, and showed that under unification nothing lay beyond the realm.
units.literal: Then he reported completion at the suburban altars, bestowed blessings on officials and people, extended great largess equitably, and showed that unification left nothing outside.

units.zh: 樞庭偃武，既編戡定之勳；
units.en: The Bureau of Military Affairs laid down arms and already compiled the record of pacification;
units.literal: The Bureau of Military Affairs rested arms and already compiled the records of pacification and settlement;

units.zh: 翰苑摛文，尋奉纂修之旨。
units.en: the Hanlin Academy took up its literary charge and soon received the imperial order to compile and revise.
units.literal: the Hanlin Academy unfolded its writings and soon received the decree for compilation and revision.

units.zh: 事幾有待，歲月易遷。
units.en: Affairs still awaited their proper moment, and the years slipped quickly by.
units.literal: Matters had to await their moment, and years easily passed.

units.zh: 累朝每切於繼承，多務未遑於制作。
units.en: Reign after reign urgently attended to succession, and amid pressing duties found no leisure for such compilation.
units.literal: Successive reigns each urgently attended to succession, and amid many affairs had no leisure for compilation.

units.zh: 臣阿魯圖等，誠惶誠恐，頓首頓首，欽惟皇帝陛下恢弘至道，紹述丕謨。
units.en: We, your servants Aruqtai and others, in deepest awe and reverence bow our heads repeatedly, respectfully considering that Your Majesty expands the utmost Way and carries forward the great design.
units.literal: Your servants Aruqtai and others, in sincere awe and sincere fear, bow our heads repeatedly, respectfully considering that Your Majesty expands the utmost Way and continues the great plan.

units.zh: 往行前言，樂討論於古訓；
units.en: You delight in the words of antiquity and take pleasure in debating the teachings of old;
units.literal: You delight in examining the words of antiquity and take pleasure in discussing ancient teachings;

units.zh: 祖宗功德，思揚厲於耿光。
units.en: and you seek to exalt and display the brilliant glory of your ancestors' merit and virtue.
units.literal: the merit and virtue of your ancestors, thinking to exalt and display their brilliant glory.

units.zh: 惟我朝大啟基圖，彼吳會後歸版籍。
units.en: Our dynasty greatly opened its founding design, and the Wu region at last returned to the imperial registers.
units.literal: Our dynasty greatly opened its founding design, and that Wu region later returned to the registers.

units.zh: 視金源其未遠，紬石室以具存，及茲累洽之時，成此彌文之典。
units.en: The Jin dynasty lies not far behind us, the stone archives remain fully preserved, and at this time of accumulated harmony we complete this enriched literary canon.
units.literal: Viewing the Jin source as not yet distant, drawing together the stone chamber so that all is preserved, and at this time of accumulated harmony completing this enriched literary canon.

units.zh: 命臣阿魯圖、左丞相臣別兒怯不花領史事，前右丞相臣脫脫為都總裁，平章政事臣帖穆爾達世、御史大夫臣惟一、翰林學士承旨臣起巖、臣玄、治書御史臣好文、禮部尚書臣沂、崇文大監臣宗瑞為總裁官，平章政事臣納麟、臣顏、前中書右丞 臣達世睦邇、左丞 臣守簡、參議 臣岳柱、臣住、臣思謙、郎中 臣斡欒、臣思立等協恭董治，史官工部侍郎 臣斡玉倫徒，秘書卿 臣泰不華、太常僉院 臣杜秉彝、翰林直學士 臣宋褧，國子司業 臣王思誠、臣澤民、集賢待制 臣干文傳、翰林待制 臣張瑾、臣師道、宣文閣鑒書博士 臣麥文貴、監察御史 臣余闕、太常博士 臣李齊、翰林修撰 臣劉聞、太醫院都事 臣賈魯、國子助教 臣馮福可、太廟署令 臣陳祖仁、西臺御史 臣趙中、翰林應奉 臣王儀、臣貞、秘書著作左郎 臣譚慥、翰林編修 臣張翥、國子助教 臣吳當、經筵檢討 臣危素編劘分局，彙粹為書。
units.en: Your Majesty appointed Aruqtai and Left Chancellor Bayan Qutlugh to direct the history project, with former Right Chancellor Toqto'a as chief director-in-chief, and Chief Directors including Chief Councillors Temür Dash, Censor-in-Chief Weiyi, Hanlin Academicians Expositor Qiyan and Xuan, Investigating Censor Haowen, Minister of Rites Yi, and Director of the Directorate of Education Zongrui; together with Chief Councillors Nalin and Yan, former Right Vice Director of the Central Secretariat Dashimur, Left Vice Director Shoujian, Counsellors Yuezhu, Zhu, and Siqian, Bureau Directors Olon and Sili, and others to assist in reverent supervision; and history officers including Vice Minister of Works Oluntur, Secretary Director Taibuhua, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Du Bingyi, Hanlin Academician Song Jiong, Rectors of the Directorate of Education Wang Sicheng and Zemin, Awaiting Editor-in-Chief of the Hall of Gathered Worthies Gan Wenchuan, Hanlin Awaiting Editors Zhang Jin and Shidao, Doctor of the Xuanwen Pavilion Mai Wengui, Investigating Censor Yu Que, Doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Li Qi, Hanlin Compiler Liu Wen, Chief Administrator of the Imperial Medical Institute Jia Lu, Instructors of the Directorate of Education Feng Fuke, Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple Office Chen Zuren, Western Censor Zhao Zhong, Hanlin Attendants Wang Yi and Zhen, Left Secretary Compiler Tan Zao, Hanlin Compiler Zhang Zhu, Instructor of the Directorate of Education Wu Dang, and Classics Lectures Reviewer Wei Su to edit in separate bureaus and gather the whole into a book.
units.literal: Your Majesty ordered your servant Aruqtai and Left Chancellor Bayan Qutlugh to direct the history project, former Right Chancellor Toqto'a as chief director-in-chief, and Chief Directors including Chief Councillors Temür Dash, Censor-in-Chief Weiyi, Hanlin Academician Expositor Qiyan, Xuan, Investigating Censor Haowen, Minister of Rites Yi, and Director of the Directorate of Education Zongrui; Chief Councillors Nalin and Yan, former Right Vice Director of the Central Secretariat Dashimur, Left Vice Director Shoujian, Counsellors Yuezhu, Zhu, and Siqian, Bureau Directors Olon and Sili, and others to assist in reverent supervision; history officers including Vice Minister of Works Oluntur, Secretary Director Taibuhua, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Du Bingyi, Hanlin Academician Song Jiong, Rectors of the Directorate of Education Wang Sicheng and Zemin, Awaiting Editor-in-Chief of the Hall of Gathered Worthies Gan Wenchuan, Hanlin Awaiting Editors Zhang Jin and Shidao, Doctor of the Xuanwen Pavilion Mai Wengui, Investigating Censor Yu Que, Doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Li Qi, Hanlin Compiler Liu Wen, Chief Administrator of the Imperial Medical Institute Jia Lu, Instructor of the Directorate of Education Feng Fuke, Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple Office Chen Zuren, Western Censor Zhao Zhong, Hanlin Attendants Wang Yi and Zhen, Left Secretary Compiler Tan Zao, Hanlin Compiler Zhang Zhu, Instructor of the Directorate of Education Wu Dang, and Classics Lectures Reviewer Wei Su to edit in separate bureaus and gather the essence into a book.

units.zh: 起自東都，迄於南渡，紀載餘三百載，始終纔一再期。
units.en: Beginning from the Eastern Capital and ending with the southward crossing, the record spans more than three hundred years, its beginning and end spanning barely two sixty-year cycles.
units.literal: Beginning from the Eastern Capital and ending at the southward crossing, the record spans more than three hundred years, from beginning to end barely two cycles.

units.zh: 考夫建隆、淳化之經營，景德、咸淳之潤色，慶曆、皇祐以忠厚美風化，元豐、熙寧以聰明紊憲章。
units.en: Consider the founding labors of the Jianlong and Chunhua eras, the cultural refinement of the Jingde and Xianchun reigns, the Qingli and Huangyou periods when generous sincerity beautified customs, and the Yuanfeng and Xining reigns when keen intelligence threw statutes and ordinances into confusion.
units.literal: Examining the founding efforts of Jianlong and Chunhua, the embellishment of Jingde and Xianchun, Qingli and Huangyou beautifying customs through generous sincerity, and Yuanfeng and Xining with keen intelligence disordering statutes and ordinances.

units.zh: 馴致紹聖紛紜，崇寧荒亂，治忽昭陳於方冊，操存實本於宮庭。
units.en: This led in turn to the turmoil of Shaosheng and the reckless disorder of Chongning—whether rule flourished or declined is set forth clearly in the written records, while conduct and self-cultivation truly had their root in the palace.
units.literal: This led in turn to the turmoil of Shaosheng and the wild disorder of Chongning; whether rule flourished or declined is set forth clearly in the written records, while conduct and preservation truly had their root in the palace.

units.zh: 若乃建炎、紹興之圖回，乾道、淳熙之保乂，正直用則人存政舉，邪佞進則臣辱主憂。
units.en: As for the recovery of the Jianyan and Shaoxing eras, the preservation and good governance of the Qiandao and Chunxi reigns—when upright men were employed, worthy men endured and government flourished; when the wicked and fawning advanced, ministers were disgraced and the ruler was troubled.
units.literal: As for the recovery of Jianyan and Shaoxing, the preservation and governance of Qiandao and Chunxi—when the upright were employed, men endured and government succeeded; when the wicked and fawning advanced, ministers were shamed and the ruler was troubled.

units.zh: 光、寧之朝，僅守宗社，理、度之世，日蹙封疆，顧乃拘信使以渝盟，納畔臣而侵境，由權奸之擅命，啟事釁以召兵。
units.en: Under the Guang and Ning reigns they barely preserved the altars of state; under Lizong and Duzong the borders shrank day by day; yet they detained envoys in violation of treaties, welcomed defecting ministers and allowed border incursions—because powerful traitors usurped authority, they provoked incidents and invited war.
units.literal: In the reigns of Guang and Ning they barely preserved the altars of state; in the eras of Li and Du the borders daily shrank; yet they detained envoys in violation of treaties, welcomed defecting ministers and allowed border incursions—because powerful traitors usurped authority, they provoked incidents and invited war.

units.zh: 厥後瀛國歸朝，吉王航海，齊亡而訪王燭，乃存秉節之臣；
units.en: Afterward Emperor Gong submitted to the court and Prince Ji took to the sea; when Qi perished they still sought out Wang Zhu—thus there remained ministers who held fast to their integrity;
units.literal: Afterward Yingguo submitted to the court and the Prince Ji took to the sea; when Qi perished they sought out Wang Zhu—thus there remained ministers who held to their integrity;

units.zh: 楚滅而諭魯公，堪矜守禮之國。
units.en: and when Chu was destroyed they still praised the Duke of Lu—a state worthy of admiration for preserving ritual.
units.literal: when Chu was destroyed they praised the Duke of Lu—a state worthy of admiration for preserving ritual.

units.zh: 載惟貞元之會合，屬當泰道之熙明。
units.en: We consider that this convergence at the founding of the Yuan belongs to an age when the Great Way shines in full brilliance.
units.literal: We consider that this convergence at the beginning of the Yuan belongs to an age when the Great Way shines brightly.

units.zh: 眾言淆亂於當時，大義昭宣於今日。
units.en: Many voices were confused and disorderly in that age; the great principle is now proclaimed clearly in our own day.
units.literal: Many voices were confused and disorderly in that time; the great principle is now proclaimed clearly in the present.

units.zh: 矧先儒性命之說，資聖代表章之功，先理致而後文辭，崇道德而黜功利，書法以之而矜式，彝倫賴是而匡扶。
units.en: Moreover, the former Confucians' teachings on nature and destiny, supporting the sage's achievement in representing the classics, putting principle first and literary ornament after, exalting moral virtue and rejecting utility and profit—the standards of historiography take this as their model, and the great human relations rely upon it for support.
units.literal: Moreover, the former Confucians' teachings on nature and destiny, supporting the sage's achievement in representing the classics, putting principle first and literary ornament after, exalting moral virtue and rejecting utility and profit—the standards of historiography take this as their model, and human relations rely upon it for support.

units.zh: 雖微董孤直筆之可稱，庶逃司馬寡識而輕信。
units.en: Although we fall short of the praise due to Dong Hu's upright brush, we may yet escape Sima Qian's fault of limited knowledge and credulous acceptance.
units.literal: Although slight compared with Dong Hu's upright brush that may be praised, we may yet escape Sima Qian's scant knowledge and light credulity.

units.zh: 至若論其有弊，亦惟斷以至公。
units.en: As for discussing its defects, we likewise judge only with utmost fairness.
units.literal: As for discussing where it has flaws, we also judge only with utmost fairness.

units.zh: 大概聲容盛而實德衰，論建多而成效少。
units.en: In general, outward display flourished while real virtue declined; proposals were many but results were few.
units.literal: In general, outward display flourished while real virtue declined; proposals were many but results few.

units.zh: 且辭之繁簡以事，而文之古今以時，舊史之傳述既多，雜記之蒐羅又廣。
units.en: Moreover, the complexity or simplicity of language follows the matter, and the antiquity or modernity of style follows the time; the old histories' transmissions are already numerous, and miscellaneous records gathered are also extensive.
units.literal: Moreover, verbosity or brevity in wording depends on the affair, and antiquity or modernity in style depends on the age; transmissions in the old histories are already many, and collections in miscellaneous records are also broad.

units.zh: 於是參是非而去取，權豐約以損增。
units.en: Therefore we weighed right and wrong and made selections, balancing fullness and brevity to add or subtract.
units.literal: Therefore we weighed right and wrong and made selections, balancing fullness and brevity to add or subtract.

units.zh: 事嚴敢計於疾徐，日積亦虞於玩愒。
units.en: The work was grave and we dared not calculate whether it went fast or slow; day by day it accumulated, yet we still feared laxity and delay.
units.literal: The work was strict and we dared not calculate whether it went fast or slow; day by day it accumulated, yet we still feared laxity and delay.

units.zh: 臣阿魯圖 等忝司當揆，實預提綱，周詢在局之言，靡不究心乃職。
units.en: We, your servants Aruqtai and others, unworthily holding the chief ministership, truly took part in directing the overall plan; we thoroughly inquired into the views of those in the bureau, and none failed to devote their full hearts to their duties.
units.literal: Your servants Aruqtai and others, unworthily holding the chief ministership, truly took part in directing the overall plan; we thoroughly inquired into the words of those in the bureau and none failed to devote their hearts to their duties.

units.zh: 第述作之才有限，而報效之志無窮。
units.en: Only our talent for composition is limited, while our resolve to repay Your Majesty's favor is boundless.
units.literal: Only our talent for composition is limited, while our resolve to repay favor is boundless.

units.zh: 儻垂清燕之觀，尚助緝熙之益。
units.en: If Your Majesty would grant a clear and tranquil audience, it would still aid the increase of brilliant governance.
units.literal: If Your Majesty would bestow a clear and tranquil audience, it would still aid the increase of brilliant governance.

units.zh: 曰若帝堯，曰若帝舜，惟聖心稽古之功；
units.en: "Oh, how like Emperor Yao! Oh, how like Emperor Shun!"—such is the sage's achievement in examining antiquity;
units.literal: "Oh, how like Emperor Yao! Oh, how like Emperor Shun!"—this is the sage's achievement in examining antiquity;

units.zh: 監於有夏，監于有殷，乃臣子告君之道。
units.en: "Take warning from Xia; take warning from Yin"—such is the way subjects report to their ruler.
units.literal: "Take warning from Xia; take warning from Yin"—this is the way subjects report to their ruler.

units.zh: 謹撰述《本紀》四十七卷，《志》一百六十二卷，《表》三十二卷，《列傳》、《世家》二百二十五卷，裝潢成四百九十二帙，隨表塵獻以聞。
units.en: We respectfully compiled forty-seven juan of Basic Annals, one hundred sixty-two juan of Treatises, thirty-two juan of Tables, and two hundred twenty-five juan of Biographies and Hereditary Houses, bound into four hundred ninety-two fascicles, and present them with this memorial, humbly raised in dust, for Your Majesty's review.
